0xd008.notes: Confirmed in lab session 2026-10-17 (guided mapping, fw 4.31). Signed, x10: -2 reads -20. Choosing ACROS sets it to 0. libgphoto2 calls it ColorMode.

0xd00b.name: WhiteBalanceShiftR
0xd00b.notes: Confirmed in lab session 2026-10-17 (guided mapping, fw 4.31). The R axis of the WB shift grid. Signed, one step per unit: R +3 reads 3. libgphoto2 calls it WhitebalanceTune1.

0xd00c.name: WhiteBalanceShiftB
0xd00c.notes: Confirmed in lab session 2026-10-17 (guided mapping, fw 4.31). The B axis of the WB shift grid. Signed, one step per unit: B -2 reads -2. libgphoto2 calls it WhitebalanceTune2.
